title: RewardRecord
description: The reward record keyed by trajectory_id. This is the canonical payload that is RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalized and KMS-signed in account B; the signature envelope is added by the reward ledger (E4). A buying lab verifies it offline against the public key.

trajectory_id.description: Join key for the whole system; a string so large opaque ids never lose precision under JCS.

attempt.description: Re-grade counter. A divergent re-grade appends a new record (a new attempt), never an overwrite.

reward.description: Execution-grounded reward — a bounded, finite double in [0,1]. The bound rejects NaN/Infinity, which are not valid JCS numbers.

reportDigest.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the diff report the reward was read from.

graderVersion.description: Pins which grader/vectors produced this reward.

gradedAt.description: Grading timestamp; a string (RFC 3339 or integer nanoseconds) so ns precision never collides with IEEE-754 number limits.

nonce.description: Verifier-issued episode nonce; binds the record to this run so a signed reward cannot be replayed.
